audit.whatIsWrong: Not one of Zaahen's abilities was named anywhere — the page tracked 'Zaahen Ultimate' as a generic clock and referred to 'his Q and E'. His passive revive was never mentioned at all.
audit.why: From the kit and the applicable-interaction list: The Darkin Glaive (Q) is an auto-attack reset that slashes twice and HEALS him, recastable into a knock-up, 10/9/8/7/6s. Aureate Rush (E) is a dash whose damage scales with the target's health — armour does not answer it, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. Grim Deliverance (R) heals him for a portion of damage dealt, 110/95/80s. His W stabs and PULLS at 850 range on 14s. And his passive stacks Determination, granting bonus AD and, when filled, a revive — a fight you win can restart.
audit.corrected: Real names, real cooldowns, the percent-health dash, and the revive all written into the phases, Do's and spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Zaahen Level 1 (why: 'Level 1 is an even skill lane') and Level 6 (why: 'the stage rides on your escape play'), then gave the 2+ item row to neither side while its why says he deletes you in any duel.
audit.why: Three rows read opposite to their own text. The packet chart resolves all three, and 44.56% over 974 games is a lane that is even at 1, hostile from 2, and unwinnable in a late duel.
audit.corrected: Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen, Zaahen, Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen — paired full/content rows with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Zaahen Ultimate' was the tracked spike with no cooldown and no name.
audit.why: Grim Deliverance is 110 seconds at rank 1 and heals him off the damage — the longest exploitable window in the matchup, and the page never gave the player the number.
audit.corrected: Named and numbered in the focus, phases and Do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization advice contained no anti-heal at all, and the page told the player defensive buys cannot close the gap without saying which stat does help.
audit.why: Two of his abilities heal him (Q on every reset, R on its damage) and his E scales with your health — so Grievous Wounds is the buy that changes the maths, and stacking armour or HP is the buy that does not.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into the first-item why and the item spike.

edits.before: Q poke only — farm, respect everything, and bank Manaflow stacks. You're buying time, not fighting.
edits.after: Neither kit is online yet — last-hit at range, bank Manaflow, and do not contest wave one.

edits.before: W root threatens jungle follow-up, but it's also your kite tool — spending it greedily is how you die.
edits.after: The Darkin Glaive resets his auto, heals him, and recasts into a knock-up every 10s at rank 1.

edits.before: Full kit: E-Flux into W root into Q chain is your trade. Fluxed minions make the wave itself your weapon.
edits.after: Aureate Rush dashes in every 10s and its damage scales with your health — armour is not the answer.

edits.before: Realm Warp opens flanks and escapes, and your EQ DPS now duels most tops on their cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Grim Deliverance heals him as it lands, 110s at rank 1 — a pre-placed Warp voids the all-in.

edits.before: Seraph's online — you out-DPS and out-tank everyone in extended fights. Side-lane and Warp to every fight.
edits.after: His passive fills into a revive, so even a fight you win can restart — never duel him late alone.

edits.before: His big cooldown — punish the gap while it is down. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Grim Deliverance is 110s at rank 1 — punish the gap while it is down, never fight into it.

edits.before: Zaahen spends Ultimate early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Zaahen spends Grim Deliverance early — the next 110 seconds of lane are yours.

edits.before: That is Zaahen’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: The Darkin Glaive is an auto-reset — watch the wind-up.

edits.before: By 3 his Q and E let him walk you down straight through your W root.
edits.after: By 3 Aureate Rush closes the gap and slices for percent health.

edits.before: His first item widens a gap your defensive buys cannot close — do not contest the lane.
edits.after: His item widens a gap armour cannot close — Grievous Wounds is the stat that helps.

edits.before: Late he gap-closes and deletes you in any duel you cannot avoid — only the map game answers him.
edits.after: Late he gap-closes and deletes you, and a filled passive revives him — only the map answers him.

edits.before: His Q and E can walk you down straight through the W root; give up trades, keep the farm.
edits.after: Aureate Rush walks you down and his Glaive recast knocks you up; give up trades, keep the farm.

edits.before: The gap widens beyond what defensive buys can close; play for the map, not the lane.
edits.after: Grievous Wounds is the buy that helps — his Q and R both heal. Play the map, not the lane.

notes: Zaahen's W has no name in either the kit file or the missing-interaction list, so it is described by effect ('stabs and pulls at 850, 14s') and never named — inventing one would be exactly the failure this audit exists to fix. QUESTION FOR THE USER, recorded rather than guessed: his passive revive is the single biggest fact on this page and there is no room in the ±10% band to add it without displacing something; it is currently written only into phases[6].why and whys[6]. If the user wants it in the TL;DR or loading screen too, those are the fields to open.
